scientific_limitations: Complex irreducible character counts are claimed only for odd finite-field order; alternating-matrix rank counts hold in every characteristic.
The graph operation is adjoining exactly two mutually nonadjacent vertices adjacent to every old vertex.
The closest published single-vertex recurrence was read at title-and-abstract level, not full text; historical priority has residual risk.
Finite verification uses prime fields and finitely many graphs and is not a substitute for the general proof.
title: Independent double-cone recurrence for graphical-group character degrees
